instrument_defect.tautological_criterion: C2_default_arm_bit_identical_to_raw_f cannot fail for any input. The driver sets agent.e3.config.f_weight = 1.0 on ARM_DEFAULT (driver:127), which is already the substrate default (config.py:991); C2 then checks abs(tick0_f_weighted - tick0_f_raw) <= 0.0 + 1e-9, where both values come from the SAME dict, SAME score_trajectory call, SAME tensor -- f and f_weight * f (e3_selector.py:1505, :1604, :1609). 1.0 * f is bit-identical in IEEE-754, so the difference is exactly 0. The only branch that could break it (use_e3_channel_commensurability, e3_selector.py:1510-1525) defaults False (config.py:1073) and is never enabled by this driver.
instrument_defect.self_declared_unfailable_precondition: The lone precondition candidate_pool_non_trivial (measured 32.0 vs threshold 1.0) is declared unfailable BY THE DRIVER ITSELF in ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT (driver:74-81): 'reachable by construction'. Two of the three criteria_non_degenerate flags are literally that same boolean; the third is the literal True.

substrate_defect_found.severity_rationale: USER-CONFIRMED `corrupting` at the Step 8 gate: the field produces a number that looks like a population statistic but is one arbitrary sample, so any downstream read of it is silently wrong while appearing valid. learning_extracted: A criterion asserting bit-identity between x and 1.0*x computed from the same tensor is an IEEE-754 identity, not a test. A readiness criterion must be shown capable of failing before it is counted as certification.

criterion_unreachable.finding: VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY BY THIS SESSION. Resources spawn 5 per episode, never respawn, 30 episodes => a hard ceiling of 150 resource events per cell. resource_visit_rate = n_resource_events / total_steps, so the ceiling rate is 150/total_steps.
criterion_unreachable.verdict: A PERFECT FORAGER collecting every resource in every episode would still have FAILED G0 in all six trained cells. The criterion could not have passed. The G0 FAIL is therefore not a measurement of the substrate.
criterion_unreachable.additional_narrowing: benefit_approach fires zero times (use_proxy_fields defaults False and is not passed; independently unreachable without proximity_approach_magnitude_tiebreak), so only transition_type == 'resource' counts toward the numerator.

dv_is_competence_inverted.finding: VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY BY THIS SESSION. The RANDOM arm scores ~4.4x the trained arms on the DV while having survival_rate EXACTLY 0.0 in all three seeds.
dv_is_competence_inverted.mechanism: The DV's denominator is total_steps. Dying at ~300 steps instead of surviving ~4000 inflates events/steps by an order of magnitude. The metric REWARDS EARLY DEATH, so any ranking read off it is inverted with respect to competence.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-899 FAILED a G0 readiness criterion that could not have passed: with 5 non-respawning resources over 30 episodes the hard ceiling is 150 events per cell, giving ceiling rates of 0.0277-0.0411 against required thresholds of ~0.057-0.066 -- a perfect forager fails in all six trained cells. The DV (resource events / total_steps) is additionally anti-correlated with competence: the RANDOM arm scores ~4.4x the trained arms while having survival_rate exactly 0.0, purely because dying at ~300 steps shrinks the denominator. Its self-route label readiness_fail_curriculum_gate_blocks_retest is a mislabel -- both readiness preconditions measured 1.0 and the run completed 9/9 cells; nothing about a curriculum gate was measured as blocking. The manifest tags no claim_ids and carries no queue_id (hand-recovered run that bypassed the spool). Run was cleared as reviewed before this adjudication existed.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: G0 readiness gate uses a resource-rate DV denominated on total_steps, making it unreachable at realistic episode lengths and anti-correlated with competence
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: resource_visit_rate = n_resource_events / total_steps has a hard numerator ceiling (5 resources x 30 episodes = 150) while the denominator grows with survival, so a competent long-surviving agent scores BELOW a random agent that dies immediately, and the threshold is unreachable even at perfect play. Re-denominate per episode or per available-resource-opportunity, and re-derive the G0 threshold against the resulting reachable range. USER-CONFIRMED at the Step 8 gate that this warrants a substrate entry so other experiments sharing this readiness gate are protected.

failure_record_entry.metric: G0 ceiling rate 0.0277-0.0411 at perfect play vs required 0.0568-0.0658 in all 6 trained cells; RANDOM (survival 0.0) outscores both trained arms ~4.4x
failure_record_entry.target: a G0 DV whose threshold is reachable at perfect play and whose ordering is not inverted with respect to survival

learning_extracted: Before a readiness criterion is queued, compute its value AT PERFECT PLAY. If the ceiling is below the threshold, the criterion is not a measurement. Here the ceiling is fixed by the environment (5 resources x 30 episodes) and was knowable before the run.

A rate DV whose denominator is total_steps rewards early death whenever the numerator is capped by the environment. Check the ordering against a random-policy control that dies: if RANDOM wins, the metric is inverted.

A self-route label emitted by elimination from an if/elif/else, with no code inspecting the condition it names, will confidently misattribute the cause. The label asserted a curriculum block that nothing measured.

A pre-queue smoke returning the degenerate value (G0_ON=0) was read as the gate 'correctly routing readiness_fail' rather than as the criterion being unreachable -- the same observation, the opposite conclusion.

cluster_pattern.shape: The emitted outcome is DECOUPLED FROM THE SCIENTIFIC QUESTION, and a readiness/precondition control fires unconditionally by construction. In all five: 849 PASS with its sole load-bearing criterion passed=false (0.0 vs 1.0); 865 the same; 864a PASS where the criterion naming the experiment is load_bearing FALSE and passed FALSE and both branches set PASS; 852 PASS on three criteria with no measured/threshold values and a discriminating criterion that is an IEEE-754 identity; 899 FAIL on a criterion that perfect play could not have satisfied. And the self-certifying readiness control: 849/865 hardcode the two flags the check reads two statements before calling it; 852's driver declares its own precondition unfailable in ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT; 864a's comment says 'trivially 1.0 by construction'; 899's curriculum_reached_p2 tests only total_steps > 0.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: This is one property of the substrate-readiness / pre-flight experiment family as authored in the 2026-08-01..2026-08-08 window, not five independent bugs. The family's verdict machinery certifies that the harness RAN, not that the substrate has the property under test -- and because the certification is constructed from values the driver itself has just set, it cannot report otherwise. The convergence across structurally different claims (Q-081 an open_question, SD-076 and SD-085 design decisions, ARC-030/MECH-307 untagged) is what makes this a family property rather than a per-experiment defect.
cluster_pattern.which_reading_is_live: test_design_ceiling is NOT the live reading here. A substrate-enrichment reading would require that the experiments tested the substrate and found it wanting; in four of five the substrate was never interrogated at all (unwired signals, an absent gate object, a tautological identity, an unreachable threshold), and in the fifth the data was collected and never analysed. The live reading is verdict_machinery_decoupled_from_question.
cluster_pattern.planning_decision_forced: Whether the readiness/pre-flight experiment family needs a standing structural check -- that at least one load-bearing criterion be demonstrated capable of BOTH outcomes before a run is queued, and that a readiness control not be computed from values the driver itself set. USER-CONFIRMED at the Step 8 gate to file as a cluster; the standing-check question is surfaced for /governance, not decided here.
cluster_pattern.re_derive_brake_note: Q-081 already stands at 2 counting ceiling autopsies (v3_exq_824a via failure_autopsy_2026-07-28-sweep.json, and v3_exq_838 via failure_autopsy_v3-exq-838_2026-07-29.json), which MEETS the default RE_DERIVE_BRAKE_THRESHOLD of 2. Both 849 and 865 RAN AFTER those two autopsies were filed (2026-07-28/29 vs 2026-08-01). Neither of this artifact's Q-081 targets ADDS to that count -- both are stamped standard with instrument-defect notes and owe no substrate build, so R3 clause 2 excludes them. Flagged for /governance: a further Q-081 probe at the same granularity is already brake-gated, and the correct next step for Q-081 is instrument repair (making the probe capable of detecting a lever at all), which is a different question from re-testing the claim.
